mutable_fact_notice: This is dated discovery evidence, not a timeless architecture constant. Refresh before any manifest freeze or execution.

claims: Requested model ID gpt-5.6-sol is currently documented.
Responses v1/responses and structured outputs are supported.
Context is 1,050,000 tokens and maximum output is 128,000 tokens.
Standard text pricing is USD 5 input, USD 0.50 cached input, and USD 30 output per million tokens.
Prompts above 272K input tokens use the documented long-context multiplier; the draft projection stays below it.
The public snapshot list does not expose a distinct immutable snapshot identifier beyond gpt-5.6-sol.
Responses supports JSON-schema structured output and reports response status and usage metadata.
Refusal, incomplete output, schema validity, and semantic validity remain separate evaluator outcomes.
Requested model ID claude-sonnet-5 is currently documented.
Context is 1,000,000 tokens and maximum output is 128,000 tokens.
Adaptive thinking replaces manual extended-thinking budgets; non-default temperature, top_p, and top_k are rejected.
max_tokens includes thinking and visible response tokens.
Refusal is returned with HTTP 200 and stop_reason refusal.
Introductory pricing is USD 2 input and USD 10 output per million through 2026-08-31, then USD 3 and USD 15.
Claude 4.6-and-later dateless model IDs are provider-documented pinned snapshots.
Model weights and configuration stay fixed for the ID, while serving infrastructure may change.
Claude Sonnet 5 supports output_config.format structured output.
The exact conservative schema family still requires bounded certification against the account endpoint.
Refusal and max-token truncation can prevent a normal schema-valid output and must fail closed.
Sonnet 5 prompt-cache hits are USD 0.20 per million through 2026-08-31 and USD 0.30 from 2026-09-01.
No cache discount is assumed in the draft preflight.
Stable v1 supports the Interactions API.
The draft endpoint is /v1/interactions; no required M6.6B-2 capability gap was found.
Interactions is GA and lists gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite as supported.
Structured output is supported.
Interactions stores requests by default, so every draft call requires store=false and no previous_interaction_id.
The documented JSON Schema subset includes object, array, string, boolean, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, and enum.
Syntactically valid structured output still requires application semantic validation.
Large or deeply nested schemas may be rejected, so exact schema acceptance remains a certification blocker.
Requested model ID gemini-3.6-flash is currently documented as stable.
Context is 1,048,576 tokens, maximum output is 65,536 tokens, and structured output and thinking are supported.
Stable labeling alone does not satisfy the project's immutable qualification identity standard.
gemini-3.6-flash should omit deprecated sampling parameters and supports thinking_level.
gemini-3.5-flash-lite recommends minimal thinking for extraction and classification.
The draft omits temperature, top_p, top_k, candidate_count, tools, and prior model turns.
Gemini 3.6 Flash standard paid pricing is USD 0.75 input, USD 3.75 output including thinking, and USD 0.075 cached input per million through 2026-12-31; rates double on 2027-01-01.
Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite standard paid pricing is USD 0.30 input, USD 2.50 output including thinking, and USD 0.03 cached input per million.
No cache discount, free tier, batch, flex, priority, grounding, or tool pricing is assumed.
API data is not used for model training unless the customer explicitly opts in.
Default abuse-monitoring logs may retain customer content for up to 30 days.
Responses application state is retained by default, so the draft requires store=false and background=false.
Modified Abuse Monitoring and Zero Data Retention are approval- and account-specific controls that must be checked in the project control plane.
Retained API data is not used for model training without express permission.
Messages and adaptive thinking are documented as ZDR-eligible for an eligible organization.
ZDR is organization-specific and requires account enablement; the effective workspace arrangement remains an account-control-plane blocker.
Paid Services do not use prompts or responses to improve Google products.
Interactions storage is enabled by default and store=false is required to opt out of interaction-state retention.
The account's paid-project and logging configuration remains an account-control-plane blocker.
